title: Yuan Dan Before the Duel
summary: Five days before the duel, Lin Dong uses the Three Yang Art and the Stone Talisman to open twenty-two meridians. He then absorbs the Yin Yang Pearls and forms an eight-star Yuan Dan, double his grandfather's four stars, and also becomes a 2nd Seal Symbol Master. Xuan Su brings his grandfather, father and Qing Tan, who have quietly come to Yan City, and he shows Lin Xiao his new Yuan Dan initial strength. In the arena Wei Tong is shocked by Lin Dong's progress. Lin Dong holds his own with the Yuan-Shattering Shuttle and the Spiral Wave against Wei Tong's Thousand Crack Palm, even though a mental barrier stops him flying away. Then a Blood Wolf Gang Symbol Master seizes Qing Tan as a hostage, and Wei Tong strikes the distracted Lin Dong.
events: Lin Dong opens twenty-two meridians with the Three Yang Art and the Stone Talisman.
The Yin Yang Pearls give him an eight-star Yuan Dan at Yuan Dan initial; he also reaches the 2nd Seal.
Wu Yun escorts Qing Tan; the family reunites with Lin Dong in Yan City through Xuan Su.
Lin Dong tests his father with the Pure Yuan Finger, and Lin Xiao sees he is at Yuan Dan initial.
The duel begins at the Yan City arena, watched by Yue Shan and Xia Wanjin.
Wei Tong uses Breaking Kill Fist and Thousand Crack Palm; Lin Dong answers with the shuttle and Spiral Wave.
A Blood Wolf Gang Symbol Master takes Qing Tan hostage, and Wei Tong strikes Lin Dong.
cultivation: Lin Dong forms an eight-star Yuan Dan and reaches Yuan Dan initial; he also becomes a 2nd Seal Symbol Master, with mental strength said to match a 3rd Seal. Wei Tong is at Yuan Dan advanced.
